mission.headTitle: To Move Apapa Forward With Better Governance & Development
mission.subTitle: Make we support long-lasting development, run government work well, and make life better for everybody wey dey Apapa through better public services, improved infrastructure, and inclusive economic growth — using Apapa position as Nigeria main port city.

vision.subTitle: To become example of strong maritime and urban local government — clean, well-connected, rich, and strong — where people dey do well and business dey move smoothly.

coreValues.desc1: We dey open and clear in everything we do, and we dey answer to the people wey we serve.
coreValues.desc2: We dey always aim for high standard for governance, service delivery, and infrastructure.
coreValues.desc3: We dey do our work with honesty and strong moral principles at all times.
coreValues.desc4: We dey welcome everybody and make sure say nobody dey left behind.
coreValues.desc5: We dey use smart and modern ideas to solve local problems in a better way.
coreValues.desc6: We dey strong to face challenges and adjust to changes so progress no go stop.

purpose.subTitle: To govern Apapa well and fairly — using the port economy, rich history, and human resources of Apapa to bring real development, protect our culture, and create opportunities for today and future generations.

commitment.subTitle: Apapa Local Government dey committed to improve infrastructure like roads, drainage, and public spaces to support residents and port activities; support economic empowerment through business-friendly policies and help for local businesses; improve social welfare by increasing access to healthcare, education, housing, and other important services; protect the environment by solving flooding, waste, and pollution issues through active, community-based solutions; and encourage civic participation by listening to citizens, involving them in governance, and keeping communication open and transparent.

history1.badge: The Rich Heritage and Legacy of Apapa
history1.headTitle: One Historic Maritime Gateway for Nigeria
history1.subTitle: Apapa Local Government Area (LGA) na one of the most important places for history and economy for Lagos State, Nigeria. From when e just be small fishing village, Apapa don grow become Nigeria main maritime and commercial center. Apapa don play big role for how Lagos take grow reach global city level.

history2.subTitle: Long before city development start, Apapa na calm settlement wey fishermen and traders dey live. Dem depend on the water side location to survive and do business. Because e close to Atlantic Ocean and Lagos Lagoon, Apapa naturally turn trade center even before colonial time, and e attract traders and settlers.

evolutionOfApapa.subTitle: During British colonial time, dem quickly see Apapa potential. Colonial government build ports, warehouses, and railway lines to support shipping and trade. Apapa grow fast become important international shipping hub and later turn the commercial heartbeat of Lagos.

history3.subTitle: Early 20th century mark big turning point when dem build Apapa Port, wey lay foundation for wetin become Nigeria most important maritime zone. Later, Tin Can Island Port join am, make Apapa house two of Nigeria busiest seaports. Dem handle about 75% of the country total import and export. Today, these ports na lifeline for Nigeria economy, dey process goods worth billions of naira every year. For just first quarter of 2023, Apapa Customs Command generate over ₦212 billion revenue, show how financially important the area be.

history4.subTitle: For 1977, Lagos State Government officially create Apapa as Local Government Area to bring governance closer to the people and reduce central control. Later on, places like Apapa Iganmu comot from am to form other local development councils.

history5.subTitle: Apapa dey Lagos State, one of Africa biggest economies with GDP of about $259.75 billion (PPP) for 2023. Apapa dey the center of this economic power. E contribution to trade, logistics, and revenue generation no get mate, and the history still dey inspire progress, innovation, and community development.

landmarkAndInfluence.subTitle: Apapa today na busy place with residential, commercial, and industrial activities. E get important national and regional landmarks like:

palace.description: For the heart of Apapa na the Palace of Kabiyesi dey — the traditional home of the community royal father and one of the sweetest landmarks for the area. As the house and celebration ground of the Kabiyesi (traditional ruler), the palace na the spiritual and cultural anchor for the people of Apapa. Many many years now, na there dem dey hold chieftaincy ceremonies, community meetings, and festivals, wey dey keep the customs and values of our people alive. The fine architecture and quiet environment dey remind us say, even with the busy ports and crowded streets of Apapa, tradition still dey stand strong. The palace no be just any building — na the connection between Apapa past, the people, and the customs wey dey hold the community together.

coreValues.description1: NPA Headquarters for Apapa na the main office wey dey control Nigeria port operations, dey oversee activities for major seaports and make sure maritime trade dey run smoothly.
coreValues.description2: One of Nigeria busiest and most strategic seaports, Tin Can Island Port dey handle plenty container cargo and play key role for Nigeria import and export economy.
coreValues.description3: Eleganza Plaza na popular commercial complex wey get shops, offices, and wholesale outlets, make am busy trade and business center for the heart of Apapa.
coreValues.description4: Family-friendly relaxation spot, Apapa Amusement Park get rides, games, and open spaces, give residents and visitors place to relax and enjoy.

history6.badge: A Thriving Cultural Mosaic at the Heart of Nigeria’s Port City
history6.subTitle: Apapa no be just port city; na diverse community full of strength and rich culture. People from different ethnic backgrounds dey live and work together, make Apapa true example of Nigeria unity in diversity.

history7.badge: Overcoming Challenges to Restore Apapa’s Economic Vitality
history7.subTitle: Even with all e importance, Apapa dey face modern challenges like bad infrastructure, flooding, and serious traffic jam—especially from trucks wey dey go port. These problems no be only local wahala; dem affect Nigeria economy, as traffic gridlock alone dey cost the country up to ₦18 trillion every year. But government and private sector dey work together to renew the area, improve infrastructure, and bring back Apapa glory as Nigeria economic engine.

executiveChairman.bannerTitle: Executive Chairman of the Local Government
executiveChairman.overview: The Executive Chairman na the main oga for the local government. E dey in charge of how policies dey implemented and how daily administration dey run. This role dey very important for local governance because the chairman dey manage executive duties and make sure say all local government activities follow the policies wey the elected council set.
executiveChairman.name: Hon. Idowu Adejumoke Senbanjo
executiveChairman.introduction: Hon. Idowu Adejumoke Senbanjo, the Executive Chairman of Apapa Local Government Council, get plenty experience from both public and private sectors. She get Bachelor of Arts (Hons) for Languages and Linguistics from University of Jos and Master of Arts for International Law and Diplomacy from University of Lagos. For her professional career, she don work as Team Head of Public Sector – South-West Region, Team Leader for Retail Banking, and Head of Corporate Affairs for Metropolitan Bank. For public service, she serve as Senior Special Assistant to Lagos State Governor on Housing and Senior Special Assistant on Poverty Eradication. As committed member of All Progressives Congress (APC), Hon. Senbanjo don contribute well well to the political and economic development of Apapa, making her a transformational leader for the community.

vision&Mission.overview: Hon. Senbanjo get strong commitment to transform Apapa to a modern port city wey go provide effective grassroots governance and development. Her administration dey focus on:

visionMissionItems.description1: Improve roads, drainage systems, and public facilities to make life better for residents.
visionMissionItems.description2: Support business growth and economic activities to create opportunities for residents.
visionMissionItems.description3: Put programmes in place to promote social welfare and ensure community safety.
visionMissionItems.description4: Promote environmental initiatives to make Apapa cleaner and healthier.

manifesto.overview: Her manifesto stand on four major focus areas which include security – traffic and transport, health, environment – infrastructure, education – skill acquisition and technology (S.H.E.E).

01.title: Security
01.content: Security dey very important for business success, especially as Apapa get strategic role for Lagos State economy. We dey strengthen our security system to ensure safety for businesses, visitors, and residents. Continuous improvement and adaptation dey key, with support from technical assistance and community partnerships.

activities.activity1: Support and work with all military and paramilitary agencies
activities.activity4: Build bus stops all around Apapa

02.title: Health
02.content: Good health no get price. Na this belief dey guide our people-focused health and wellness programmes. Over the past four years, we don get fully equipped ambulance for emergencies and strengthen primary healthcare services.

activities.activity1: Run 24-hour healthcare services at Ijora Oloye, Nanti Village, and Oluwole health centres
activities.activity2: Work with state government to sustain community health insurance scheme
activities.activity4: Create awareness for killer diseases like hypertension
activities.activity6: Develop social welfare system for senior citizens

03.title: Environment
03.content: Environmental Sector and Waste Management Department dey responsible for monitoring environmental issues wey fit affect people health and controlling factors wey fit cause harm.

activities.activity1: Regular desilting of drainage channels to reduce flooding
activities.activity4: Fumigation of schools, markets, and drainage areas
activities.activity7: Work with stakeholders on ESG governance model

04.title: Education
04.content: We believe say knowledge na power and skills na tools for transformation. We dey invest in education, skill acquisition, and information technology to prepare the next generation.

activities.activity4: Rebuild and equip skills acquisition centre

viceChairman.bannerTitle: Vice Chairman of the Local Government
viceChairman.overview: The Vice Chairman be the second-in-command to the Executive Chairman and dey help run the affairs of the local government. E dey support the Chairman and fit take over when the Chairman no dey available.
viceChairman.name: Hon. Ganiu Ismail
viceChairman.introduction: Ganiu Ismail Alabi, wey plenty people know as Ciroma, na dedicated public servant and community leader. Right now, e dey serve as the Vice Chairman of Apapa Local Government, and e don dey hold the position since 2021. E attend Olowogbowo Methodist School, Isale Eko Grammar School, and Ambrose Alli University, wey dem dey call Edo State University before. Mr. Alabi don get plenty experience for public service and community leadership. Before, e serve as Personal Assistant to His Royal Majesty, Oba Abdulwasiu Omogbolahan Lawal (Abisogun II), CON, the Oniru of Iruland, when the King dey serve as Commissioner for Agriculture and later Commissioner for Housing for Lagos State. His experience for public service also include serving as a Councillor representing Ward E, Ijora Oloye, and as Deputy Executive Secretary of Apapa Local Government. Through all the leadership positions wey e don hold, Mr. Alabi don show strong commitment to public service, community development, good leadership, and making life better for the people wey e represent.

councilManager.overview: Council Manager for local government na di pesin wey dey handle di everyday administrative work and management of di local government activities, and e dey act as di chief executive officer.
councilManager.name: MRS ADEBANJI S.O
councilManager.introduction: HAdebanji Sonate Oluwatoyin na an experienced public administrator and management professional wey currently dey serve as the Head of Administration/Council Manager, Apapa Local Government. She don build a strong career for public service through good leadership, effective administration, and commitment to good governance and community development. Mrs. Adebanji start her education at Alafaia Nursery/Primary School for 1980. She later attend Awori College, Ojo (1981–1984), Ajao Estate High School (1985–1986), and Ansar-Ud-Deen College (1986–1988). She later earn a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in History from Lagos State University (1989–1992). She na a Member of the Chartered Institute of Personnel Management of Nigeria (CIPM) and Institute of Public Administration of Nigeria (IPAN), showing her commitment to professional growth and continuous learning. Mrs. Adebanji get strong experience for policy implementation, budget management, community relations, council liaison, staff training, and compensation management. She dey promote accountability, efficiency, and quality service delivery. As Head of Administration/Council Manager, she provides administrative leadership, coordinates policy implementation, oversees Council operations, and ensures effective public service delivery. Her leadership dey reflect professionalism, integrity, hard work, and commitment to good governance. Outside her official duties, Mrs. Adebanji enjoys reading books, which shows her passion for learning and personal development.

keyFunctions.description1: To lead di general administration of di local government, make sure say all policies wey di elected council set dey carried out, and to oversee di work of all local government departments.

keyFunctions.description3: To oversee how di local government budget dey prepared and implemented, make sure say money dey shared well and responsibly, and monitor spending so e no go pass di approved budget.
keyFunctions.description4: To employ, supervise, and manage senior staff, including department heads, and make sure say all local government services dey delivered well and on time. To give leadership, support, and performance assessment to staff.
keyFunctions.description5: To act as di main link between di elected council and di local government administration. To prepare reports, give advice, and make sure say di council dey informed about important issues, challenges, and opportunities.
keyFunctions.description6: To lead long-term planning and community development efforts, focus on local needs, and guide di local government towards sustainable growth and development.
keyFunctions.description7: To engage with di community to understand dia needs, attend to dia concerns, and make sure say local government services meet public expectations. To also act as di spokesperson for di local government on public matters.
keyFunctions.description8: To make sure say di local government dey operate according to all laws, regulations, and policies at local, state, and federal levels.
keyFunctions.description9: To lead di local government response during emergencies or crisis, including coordinating resources, managing public information, and ensuring effective response.

headWorksAndInfrastructure.overview: Oga for Works and Infrastructure Department dey oversee plan, development, and maintenance of infrastructure projects for organization or local government.
headWorksAndInfrastructure.name: ENGR. OLUWADAMILOLA SAMSON OYEGBAMI
headWorksAndInfrastructure.introduction: Engr. Damilola Samson Oyegbami, MNSE, COREN na Deputy Director (Engineering). E study Electronic & Electrical Engineering and obtain Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology, Ogbomoso. After that, e continue im education at Lagos State University, Ojo, where e obtain a Master of Business Administration (MBA) with specialization in International Business Management. The Lagos State Local Government Commission employ am in April 2003, and e was posted to Alimoso Local Government. In October 2003, when dem create 37 Local Council Development Areas from the existing 20 Local Government Areas, e was posted to Igando-Ikotun Local Council Development Area. In January 2018, e was appointed as Head of Works & Infrastructure Department and posted to Ikorodu-North Local Council Development Area. In January 2022, e was deployed to Oshodi-Isolo Local Government. Then, in January 2023, e was deployed to Apapa Local Government, where e still dey serve as the Head of Works & Infrastructure.

keyFunctions.description1: Dey lead different construction and infrastructure projects, make sure say dem finish am on time, within budget, and according to correct specification.
keyFunctions.description2: Dey plan long-term strategy for infrastructure development and maintenance, and make projects align with community or organization goals.

keyFunctions.description5: Dey supervise and coordinate engineers, architects, and construction workers, to make teamwork and productivity better.

keyFunctions.description8: Dey identify risks wey fit happen for infrastructure projects and put plan to reduce or stop the risk.

headAgricAndSocialServices.badgeTitle: OGA/HEAD OF AGRIC AND SOCIAL SERVICES
headAgricAndSocialServices.overview: Oga for Agriculture and Social Services Department dey focus on how to improve farming productivity and also promote social welfare for people for the community or organization.
headAgricAndSocialServices.name: Mr Akinola Moshood Olalekan
headAgricAndSocialServices.introduction: Akinola Moshood Olalekan na dedicated civil servant with plenty experience for local government administration and agricultural development. E start im education for Ebenezer African Church (EAC) Primary School, where e attend from 1974 to 1980, and later complete im secondary education at Liberty Academy Secondary School in 1985. E continue im education at the University of Ibadan, where e study from 1990 to 1995, and later further im education at Lagos State University (LASU), where e obtain a Master’s degree in 2012. Im civil service career start in 2004 at Ajeromi-Ifelodun Local Government, where e work for 14 years before e became Head of the Department of Agriculture and was later posted to Badagry Local Government. Because of im dedication, professionalism, and strong work ethic, im tenure for the position was extended for more than four years, instead of the usual three-year period. In 2019, while e dey serve as HOD Agriculture in Badagry, e contributed to the achievement of 4th place at the Lagos State Community Day Celebrations, where Yenawa/Afolio Community Development Association (CDA) was recognized as one of the best communities for successful project execution. With many years of experience in public service, Akinola remains committed to effective administration, agricultural development, and creating meaningful impact in the community.

keyFunctions.description2: Dey develop and run social programs to improve people life—like health services, education initiatives, and poverty reduction strategies.

keyFunctions.description4: Dey encourage agricultural research to bring new methods and technology wey fit improve food production and sustainability.

keyFunctions.description7: Dey check how effective programs and initiatives be, gather data to measure impact, and improve things when necessary.
keyFunctions.description8: Dey do workshops and trainings for farmers and community members to build skill and knowledge for agriculture and social services.

headEducationAndLibraryServices.badgeTitle: OGA/HEAD OF EDUCATION AND LIBRARY SERVICES
headEducationAndLibraryServices.overview: Oga for Education and Library Services Department dey oversee education programs and library services for a community or organization.
headEducationAndLibraryServices.name: Mrs. Dally Modupe M.
headEducationAndLibraryServices.introduction: Mrs. Dally Mutiat Modupe na the Head of the Education Department at Apapa Local Government. She obtain her Nigeria Certificate in Education (NCE) from Lagos State College of Education, Epe, where she study English Language and Social Studies Education. Later, she earn a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) degree from Lagos State University (LASU). She get plenty experience for the education sector, having worked in five different Local Government Areas before her current appointment in Apapa. She also teach for Lagos State Polytechnic Staff School and previously serve as the Head of the Education Department at Igbogbo/Bayeku LCDA, where she contribute significantly to educational administration and development. Mrs. Dally dey committed to improving quality education and creating opportunities for every child to succeed. Her vision na to make sure say every student in Apapa get access to quality, sustainable education inside a happy, safe, and conducive learning environment, so dem fit achieve academic excellence and develop fully in other areas of life.

She don gather valuable experience for both banking and public sectors, where she show strong skills for leadership, marketing, and managing organizations. She don work for the banking sector before, where she serve as the Head of Marketing Section, overseeing marketing activities and helping the institution grow and develop. She also get experience working with local government, where she gain better understanding of public administration and how to provide services wey focus on the needs of the community. Through her professional journey, Mrs. Akinlehin don build strong commitment to excellence, good leadership, and providing effective service to both her organization and community.

headWomenAffairsAndPovertyAlleviation.introduction: Mrs. Okunade Oluwakemi Raheemat dey work with the Department of Women Affairs and Poverty Alleviation as an Assistant Director of Education (Grade Level 15). She get a Master’s Degree in Educational Management from Lagos State University (LASU), Ojo, Lagos State. She be a member of the Nigerian Association for Educational Administration and Planning (NAEAP) and the Chartered Institute of Public Management of Nigeria (CIPM). This one show her commitment to professional excellence and effective public service. Mrs. Okunade dey passionate about using education and social development to empower communities. Outside her professional responsibilities, she enjoys reading, travelling, and playing games. These interests help contribute to her well-rounded approach to leadership and personal growth.

keyFunctions.description1: Dey design and implement policies wey promote gender equality, support women rights, and reduce poverty; fit include advocacy for legal and social reforms.

headPrimaryHealthCareService.name: Dr. Oyewole Foluso
headPrimaryHealthCareService.introduction: Dr. Oyewole Foluso na a dedicated Medical Officer of Health and Public Health Physician wey get plenty experience for healthcare and public health service. He currently dey serve as a Director on Grade Level 17, where he dey use im knowledge and experience to support public health and improve the well-being of the community. Dr. Oyewole get im Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) degree from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology (LAUTECH), Ogbomoso, and later get Master of Public Health (MPH) from the University of Lagos. He join the Lagos State Government as a Medical Officer of Health, where he don build a career focused on healthcare delivery, preventing diseases, promoting good health, and improving the well-being of communities. Through im professional journey, Dr. Oyewole don show strong commitment to public health, medical service, leadership, and community development.

keyFunctions.description1: Dey design, implement, and oversee primary health care programs—maternal/child health, immunization, disease prevention, and health education.

keyFunctions.description3: Dey lead and manage health workers (doctors, nurses, community health workers), give training, and ensure quality service.

keyFunctions.description9: Dey oversee department budget, make sure resources dey used efficiently and effectively to support primary health care.

headEnvironmentalServices.overview: Oga for Environmental Services dey oversee how environment go dey managed and protected for organization or community.
headEnvironmentalServices.name: MR OBIKOYA BABATUNDE ISAAC
headEnvironmentalServices.introduction: Sanitarian Obikoya Babatunde Isaac dem born am on 8th February 1972 for Epe General Hospital, Lagos State. Na Idena Town for Agbowa-Ikosi-Ejirin LCDA, Lagos State, he come from. He do him early education for Solomon Primary School and Epe Grammar School, before he later study for College of Health Technology, Lagos State, Federal University of Technology, Owerri (FUTO), and Adekunle Ajasin University. He also belong to different professional bodies. He start him career for Local Government service for 1994, and he don serve for different councils including Ojo, Ajeromi-Ifelodun, Bariga LCDA, Surulere, and Onigbongbon LCDA. Over the years, he don show strong dedication, professionalism, and commitment to public service. His work for environmental sanitation and local government administration don earn am recognition, especially because of the important work he don do to improve environmental cleanliness for different communities.Apart from him career, he really love football. He represent him school and community for football, and through the game, he develop values like teamwork, discipline, and perseverance, which still guide am for him public service today. Right now, he dey focused on helping to transform Apapa Local Government, with the aim of bringing back its environmental beauty and making am a clean, safe, and welcoming community.

keyFunctions.description1: Dey develop and implement policies/strategies to protect environment, ensure sustainability, and comply with environmental rules/standards.
keyFunctions.description2: Dey manage waste management, recycling, pollution control, water/air quality, and land conservation programs to reduce environmental harm.
keyFunctions.description3: Dey oversee sustainable use of natural resources—energy efficiency, water conservation, and recycling initiatives.

keyFunctions.description8: Dey monitor effectiveness of programs, track indicators, and improve as needed.
keyFunctions.description9: Dey develop plans/protocols for environmental emergencies like spills, pollution events, or natural disasters.

clerkOfLegislativeArm.overview: Clerk of the Legislative Arm na key admin officer wey dey oversee legislative process and ensure legislative body (like parliament/council) dey run smoothly.
clerkOfLegislativeArm.name: Mr Adebomi  Abayomi. O.
clerkOfLegislativeArm.introduction: Adetokunboh Adelaja Kayode na an accomplished public administrator, Human Resource Management professional, and dedicated civil servant wey dey work with Lagos State Government. E currently dey serve as the Legislative Clerk for Apapa Local Government, where e dey provide administrative, procedural, and technical support for the Legislative Council. With im plenty experience for public service, e dey committed to promoting organizational excellence, transparency, accountability, and good governance through effective legislative administration and strategic leadership. Adelaja start im educational journey for Jehovah Shalom Primary School, Basua, Somolu, where e study from 1985 to 1990. After that, e go Igbobi College, Yaba, for im secondary education between 1991 and 1996. Later, e obtain Bachelor of Arts (B.A. Hons.) for Linguistics/Yoruba from University of Lagos (UNILAG), where e study from 2002 to 2007. E be Associate Member of the Chartered Institute of Personnel Management of Nigeria (ACIPM). This one show say e dey committed to professional excellence, continuous learning, and improving human resource management practices. As the Legislative Clerk, Mr. Adelaja dey responsible for preparing council agendas, recording proceedings and votes, drafting minutes, managing legislative documents, coordinating council meetings, and keeping official records. As the person wey dey take care of the Council's records, e dey make sure say the Council follow legislative rules and procedures, while e dey support effective law-making, oversight functions, and communication among council members, management, and stakeholders. Im work dey contribute greatly to strengthening transparency, accountability, and effective governance at the grassroots level. Im professional areas of expertise include legislative administration, public administration, human resource management, records management, organizational leadership, human relations, talent discovery and development, emotional intelligence, employee training and development, compensation management, and strategic coordination. Throughout im career, e don consistently show strong passion for developing people, creating productive work environments, and implementing policies wey support institutional growth and effective service delivery. Adelaja's leadership dey stand out because of professionalism, integrity, diligence, empathy, and im strong commitment to excellence in public service. Outside im professional responsibilities, e enjoy watching movies and reading books. These activities help am continue learning, develop personally, and maintain balanced lifestyle. Mr. Adetokunboh Adelaja Kayode happily marry and e blessed with three children. E dey live for Lagos, Nigeria, and e remain passionate about advancing legislative administration, excellence for the public sector, and community development.

keyFunctions.description1: Dey help prepare legislative agenda and documents for council sessions, make sure members get materials on time.
keyFunctions.description2: Dey keep correct records of proceedings—debates, votes, and decisions; prepare official minutes, transcripts, and reports.
keyFunctions.description3: Dey guide lawmakers on rules and procedures to ensure dem follow correct process and comply with rules.
keyFunctions.description4: Dey manage admin work—coordinate communication between lawmakers, staff, and public; handle correspondence; organize committee meetings.
keyFunctions.description5: Dey assist draft/review bills and track am as e dey move through the legislative process.
keyFunctions.description6: Dey ensure proceedings and decisions dey accessible to public—promote transparency and public access to records/documents.
keyFunctions.description7: For some places, Clerk fit oversee election of officers inside legislative body (like Speaker/President).
keyFunctions.description8: Dey support Speaker/Chairperson during sessions—manage agenda and coordinate order of business.
keyFunctions.description9: Dey ensure legislative body follow legal/constitutional requirements and comply with rules of order and statutory obligations.

E get B.Sc. in Computer Science from the University of Ibadan and a Master’s degree in Information Technology from the University of Lagos. E be a Chartered Information Technology Practitioner (C.ITP) and proud member of the Computer Professional Registration Council of Nigeria (CPN). Through im leadership in ICT, e dey play an important role in advancing digital transformation initiatives that empower communities and strengthen the overall performance of the organization.

headTourismUnit.introduction: Mrs. Alogba na professional for public administration and tourism, with strong academic and professional background. She attend St. Paul Primary School and RSS for her early education. She obtain Ordinary National Diploma (OND) from Yaba College of Technology, B.Sc. in Public Administration from Lagos State University, and Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) from the National Institute for Hospitality and Tourism (NIHOTOUR). headProcurementUnit.overview: Oga for Procurement Unit for local government dey manage and oversee buying process for goods, services, and works for local government operations.
headProcurementUnit.name: Mr Kadiri Lukman
headProcurementUnit.introduction: Olayiwola na public administration, finance and procurement professional with plenty experience for public sector. E get NCE in Accounting (Merit) from Federal College of Education, Yola, wey dey affiliated with Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. After that, e obtain Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in Public Administration, Second Class Lower Division, from Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria, and Master of Business Administration (MBA) from Ladoke Akintola University of Technology, Ogbomoso. E also get professional certificate from the Chartered Institute of Purchasing and Supply Management of Nigeria. E start im public service career as Finance Assistant I on Grade Level 6, using im NCE qualification. E gradually rise through the ranks until e reach Grade Level 12 as a Principal Accounting Officer. Later, e move into the Procurement Cadre, where e became Head of Unit on Grade Level 13, and subsequently rose to im current Grade Level 15 position. As Head of Administrative and Human Resource, Mrs. Olubunmi dey play an important role in improving administrative efficiency, encouraging employee engagement, and promoting best practices in public sector human resource management. Outside her professional responsibilities, she enjoys watching movies and reading books. These interests contribute to her continuous learning, personal growth, and balanced lifestyle.
